name: imf_get_dataflows
description:
The key structure of one IMF database (dataflow): its dimensions in key order and, for each, the codes it accepts (id and name), from the IMF's structure metadata. Build an imf_get_data key by joining one code per dimension with dots; leave a position empty to take every code, or join codes with + to take several.
Returns: database, flow (agency,id), name, key_template, dimensions (position, id, code_count, codes (id, name), truncated), source.
Inputs (* required): database* (dataflow id such as WEO, CPI, BOP, ER, MFS_IR, PCPS); dimension (one dimension id only, e.g. INDICATOR); search (text matched against code ids and names); limit (codes per dimension, 1-500; default 50).
Example: {"database": "WEO", "dimension": "INDICATOR", "search": "debt"}

database.description: IMF dataflow id (see imf_get_databases), e.g. WEO, CPI, BOP

search.description: Text to match in code ids and names

metadata.author: Ashutosh Sinha
metadata.note: Explore available indicators and dataflows within IMF databases.
